```
module grades.scoring
  purpose: Convert numeric scores to letter grades and analyze grade distributions.

public type Grade is one of
  A
  B
  C
  D
  F
end

public function letter_grade(score: Integer) returns Grade
  purpose: Convert a numeric score to a letter grade using standard cutoffs.
  example: letter_grade(score: 95) is A
  example: letter_grade(score: 85) is B
  example: letter_grade(score: 75) is C
  example: letter_grade(score: 65) is D
  example: letter_grade(score: 55) is F

  if score is at least 90 then
    return A
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return B
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return C
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then
    return D
  otherwise
    return F
  end
end

public function grade_distribution(scores: List of Integer)
  returns Map of Grade to Integer
  purpose: Count how many students received each letter grade.
  example: grade_distribution(scores: [95, 85, 75, 65, 55]) is {"A": 1, "B": 1, "C": 1, "D": 1, "F": 1}

  let grades be
    for each score in scores
    collect letter_grade(score: score)

  let distribution be {}
  set distribution to distribution.set(key: A, value: 0)
  set distribution to distribution.set(key: B, value: 0)
  set distribution to distribution.set(key: C, value: 0)
  set distribution to distribution.set(key: D, value: 0)
  set distribution to distribution.set(key: F, value: 0)

  for each grade in grades
    let current_count be distribution.get(key: grade) otherwise 0
    set distribution to distribution.set(key: grade, value: current_count + 1)
  end

  return distribution
end
```

```
module grades.scoring
  purpose: Convert numeric scores to letter grades and analyze grade distributions.

import std.json exposing ToJson, FromJson

public type Grade is one of
  A
  B
  C
  D
  F
end

public type GradeDistribution
  has count_a: Integer
  has count_b: Integer
  has count_c: Integer
  has count_d: Integer
  has count_f: Integer
  can ToJson
end

public function score_to_grade(score: Integer)
  returns Grade
  purpose: Convert a numeric score (0-100) to a letter grade using standard cutoffs.
  example: score_to_grade(score: 95) is A
  example: score_to_grade(score: 85) is B
  example: score_to_grade(score: 75) is C
  example: score_to_grade(score: 65) is D
  example: score_to_grade(score: 55) is F

  if score is at least 90 then
    return A
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return B
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return C
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then
    return D
  otherwise
    return F
  end
end

public function count_grades(scores: List of Integer)
  returns GradeDistribution
  purpose: Count how many scores fall into each letter grade category.
  example: count_grades(scores: [95, 85, 75, 65, 55]) is GradeDistribution(count_a: 1, count_b: 1, count_c: 1, count_d: 1, count_f: 1)

  let mutable a_count be 0
  let mutable b_count be 0
  let mutable c_count be 0
  let mutable d_count be 0
  let mutable f_count be 0

  for each score in scores
    let grade be score_to_grade(score: score)
    match grade
      when A then set a_count to a_count + 1
      when B then set b_count to b_count + 1
      when C then set c_count to c_count + 1
      when D then set d_count to d_count + 1
      when F then set f_count to f_count + 1
    end
  end

  return GradeDistribution(count_a: a_count, count_b: b_count, count_c: c_count, count_d: d_count, count_f: f_count)
end
```
